Text A. I have to tidy my room every Saturday. I put books on the shelf and clothes in the closet. I don’t have to clean the whole house. Dad helps with the heavy furniture.

Text B. I set the table before dinner. Afterwards, I have to clear the bowls and mugs. My sister washes up today, so I don’t need to wash the plates. We change jobs tomorrow.

Text C. Grandma is visiting on Sunday. I have to make the guest bed and put a mirror on the table. She needn’t bring towels because we have extra ones. I will show her round our new home.
